_meta.notes: Optimized hooks using HOOK-PLAYBOOK formulas. Each product has primary hook + 2 variants for A/B testing. Clips matched to hook emotional energy.

1.name: CeraVe Moisturizing Cream

primary.opening_line: My dermatologist is gonna hate me for this $19 secret...
primary.why_it_works: Creates curiosity (what secret?), borrows authority (dermatologist), adds controversy (hate me), price shock

variant_a.opening_line: I called this cream basic for 3 years... then I saw my skin
variant_a.why_it_works: Transformation arc in seconds, relatability for skeptics

variant_b.opening_line: POV: your skin before and after this $19 tub... I wasn't ready
variant_b.why_it_works: Visual promise, emotional stakes, price anchoring

1.voiceover_script: My dermatologist is gonna hate me for this 19 dollar secret... CeraVe moisturizing cream. The big tub. Ceramides and hyaluronic acid for under 20 bucks... Link in bio.

2.name: Neutrogena Beach Defense SPF 70

primary.opening_line: I stopped burning after I found this $8 cheat code
primary.why_it_works: Problem-solution implied, price shock, 'cheat code' energy appeals to young audience

variant_a.opening_line: Nobody told me SPF could feel like this and I'm mad
variant_a.why_it_works: FOMO activation, relatable frustration about past bad sunscreens

variant_b.opening_line: This $8 sunscreen replaced my $40 one... here's the catch
variant_b.why_it_works: Value comparison, 'catch' creates curiosity about a twist

2.voiceover_script: I stopped burning after I found this 8 dollar cheat code... Neutrogena Beach Defense. SPF 70 that actually absorbs. No oil slick energy. Link in bio.

variant_b.opening_line: You said this paste can't fix burnt pans. Watch.
variant_b.why_it_works: Direct challenge creates anticipation, proof-is-coming energy

3.voiceover_script: I called this pink paste a scam for 2 years... watch this. The Pink Stuff. Under 5 bucks. This transformation is about to violate you. Link in bio.

4.name: Dash Mini Waffle Maker

primary.opening_line: ...anyway that's why I own 4 of these now
primary.why_it_works: Pattern interrupt (mid-story), curiosity about backstory, implies repeat purchases

variant_a.opening_line: I bought this as a joke and now it's 6am and I can't stop

variant_b.opening_line: Nobody told me about the $10 waffle hack and I'm upset

4.voiceover_script: Anyway that's why I own 4 of these now... Dash Mini Waffle Maker. 10 bucks. The cutest little breakfast you'll ever make. Link in bio.

5.name: BISSELL Little Green

primary.opening_line: What came out of my 'clean' couch... I might need therapy
primary.why_it_works: Morbid curiosity (most engaging emotion), ironic quotes on 'clean', extreme reaction

variant_a.opening_line: I didn't want to show you this... but you need to see it
variant_a.why_it_works: Reluctance implies it's bad, 'need' creates urgency

variant_b.opening_line: POV: finding out your furniture is a crime scene
variant_b.why_it_works: Dramatic framing, POV format performs well on TikTok

5.voiceover_script: What came out of my 'clean' couch... I might need therapy. BISSELL Little Green. Worth every penny of that 110. This is the water that came out. Link in bio.
